facts.fact: The African Development Bank published the award of lot 2 of a Mobile ID infrastructure tender for Tunisia's Communication Technologies Ministry to FOCUS Technology Solutions, covering IT equipment, for 36,414 DT plus USD 1,550,977.60 including tax, with lots 1 and 3 unsuccessful.

TUN.note: Nothing on a civil register link.
A hardware purchase says nothing on who operates or maintains the ID system.
Nothing on registers keyed on the ID number.
The notice does not say Mobile ID is part of a national ID system issuing unique credentials.
